The motivation of this paper is to study aggregative games with coupling constraints and to design an efficient distributed algorithm to seek GNE of the games. The principal contributions of this paper can be outlined as follows:

- 1) We provide a novel communication-efficient distributed GNE an event-triggered mechanism to decrease transmission rounds and a stochastic compressor to minimize transmitted bits.
- 2) Besides   achieving efficient   communication; algorithm ensures convergence t0 exact GNE by developing precise step size conditions (Theorem 1). In contrast to existing GNE seeking works ensuring accuracy [21], our proposed algorithm further reduces the communication cost.
- 3) We show is achieved under a stochastic compressor (Theorem 2). Particularly, the algorithm guarantees asymptotic convergence to the GNE and privacy protection simultaneously.
